localChanges: Computer players now build another ship to explore with while their first one is busy ferrying units to other islands, so they no longer explore less of the map once they start settling overseas (closes #440).

log: A ship that is ferrying (cargo aboard, or ferried in the last turn) no longer counts as the player's explorer ship, so `explorerShipFor` can build another one, and an empty transport skips a port another transport is already sailing for (civ-clone/web-renderer#440).

An idle defender with no city on its own landmass that wants it becomes a 'garrison' passenger for a city of the player's on another landmass that is short of the defenders it keeps, one per city at a time (civ-clone/web-renderer#441).
